name: Cargo Volume
description: A control box with a box of space above it (outlined in build mode). Frozen (F on it, or a data signal), it holds every loose thing mostly inside the box fast to the construct: no physics, its weight carried. Unfrozen, they go free at the construct's speed. Set its size with the configure tool (drag the face handles, or type it in).

config.label: Starts frozen
config.tooltip: A newly built volume starts frozen (a blueprint's cargo rides in one).

config.label: Width
config.tooltip: The box's size across the part (its x).

config.label: Height
config.tooltip: The box's size up from the part (its y).

config.label: Length
config.tooltip: The box's size along the part (its z).

config.label: Centre x
config.tooltip: Where the box's centre is from the part (x).

config.label: Centre y
config.tooltip: Where the box's centre is from the part (y; above it by default).

config.label: Centre z
config.tooltip: Where the box's centre is from the part (z).
